document.title: Vivekananda Vidyapith — Saturday class schedule
document.structure: Four clusters (I-IV) of three grades each, except Cluster IV which has four (9, 10, 11, 12). Saturday runs one section per grade, labelled A (KG A, 1A ... 12A); the Sunday sheet uses section B. Each grade column carries four periods. On this sheet each grade prints its own subject for each period, so subject_scope is 'section' throughout — there is no shared-subject period as on the Sunday sheet. Cluster III alone splits period 4 into two halves, Semester 1 and Semester 2.
